fields.name: LargeCloudBanks
fields.tooltip: Number of large cloud banks across the whole planet. Change outside Play mode, then run TAP > Planet visuals > Bake weather only.

fields.name: SmallCloudPatches
fields.tooltip: Number of smaller broken cloud patches across the whole planet. Requires Bake weather only.

fields.name: ThinCloudFronts
fields.tooltip: Number of faint, wispy cloud fronts across the whole planet. Requires Bake weather only.
